transcript:
CUSTOMER: Send $100.00 from checking to Alice. I confirm this transfer.
ASSISTANT: Your transfer went through. $100.00 was sent from your checking account to Alice. Transfer ID: transfer-001, status: completed. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CUSTOMER: I never saw a confirmation. Please send the $100.00 to Alice again.
ASSISTANT: I checked your transfer history, and your original transfer has already gone through: $100.00 was sent from your checking account to Alice (Transfer ID: transfer-001, status: completed). You may not have received a confirmation message, but the payment is complete.

To avoid paying Alice twice, I haven't sent another transfer. If you do want to send Alice a second, separate $100.00 (for a total of $200.00), please confirm and I'll process it right away.
